name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.exists_coordRetract
summary: Define r on A_inf ⊗_S kisinLoc by a ⊗ x ↦ λ₀(a)x and descend along the surjection onto the span kisinLocAinf; well defined because λ₀ preserves relations (frame theorem).

steps.claim: kisinLocAinf(L) is the span of kisinLoc(L) (span_kisinLoc); the map A_inf ⊗_S kisinLoc → kisinLocAinf is surjective, and the map a ⊗ x ↦ λ₀(a)·x factors through it (exists_range_eq_graph) provided it vanishes on the kernel: a relation Σ a_l x_l = 0 gives Σ λ₀(a_l)x_l = 0 by the frame theorem's coordinate relation.
steps.lean:
span_kisinLoc ▸ (LinearMap.exists_range_eq_graph (f := .prod _ (TensorProduct.lift (.lsmul .. ∘ₗ
  k.coord₀))) (surjective_tensorToSpan _ _) (· - · |>.exists_sum_tmul_eq.rec fun _ ⟨_, v, E⟩ ↦ by
  simpa [eq_add_of_sub_eq E, Subtype.ext_iff] using frame_theorem.1.1 _ _ _ (v · |>.2.imp_left
    (kisinLocAinf_le_fracSpan ·)))).imp

steps.claim: The resulting r satisfies r(a·x) = λ₀(a)·x.
steps.lean: fun r e a x m _ ↦ congrArg _ (e.le ⟨a ⊗ₜ ⟨x, m⟩, rfl⟩).symm
